sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: Trait rolls using a character's Spellcast trait when a feature requires one.
When: Use only when the feature, spell, or card calls for a Spellcast Roll.
Not When: Do not ask for a Spellcast Roll just because magic is nearby; pick the correct trait or feature procedure.
Answer: Use your Spellcast trait when the feature says to make a Spellcast Roll.
Example: Marlowe's magic feature may call for an Instinct-based Spellcast Roll.
Aliases: spellcast spellcast roll spell roll cast a spell
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
